items.title: Company Name & Parent
items.summary: BritSync International is a subsidiary of NobleRoot Ltd.
items.content: BritSync International is the AI engineering and digital marketing division of NobleRoot Ltd. NobleRoot Ltd. is a London-based AI startup founded in October 2023.

items.title: Mission & Vision
items.summary: Harness AI to empower businesses and individuals.
items.content: NobleRoot's mission is to become a billion-pound cash-reserved company within the next decade by establishing a diverse portfolio of global businesses. The vision involves developing advanced AI tools that enable clients to thrive and achieve meaningful growth. BritSync's mission: Empower businesses and talent through practical AI innovation.

items.title: Business Wings
items.content:
NobleRoot operates through three business wings:
- Noblesource: Merchandising, garments industry, trading precious and normal gemstones
- Britsync (our division): Social media management, marketing services, and AI engineering
- Noblestudy: Student admissions to educational institutions in Bangladesh, UK, Europe, and USA

items.title: Our Products
items.content:
Products:
- LeadHunter: Lead generation and email outreach automation
- BritTrade: AI crypto trading bot
- BritTube: AI long-form video generation
- BritSee: Team AI chat with private memory layers (Launched May 2026)

items.title: Our Services

items.content: Services: Voice agents, agentic AI, marketing bots, content automation, ERP, custom apps.

items.title: Financial Projections
items.summary: Y2 target: 150K GBP, Q1 secured: 18K GBP.
items.content:
Financial projections for next 6 months:
- Target revenue: 150,000 GBP
- Expected net profit: 136,000 GBP
- Key expenses: 7,000 GBP salaries/subscriptions, 7,000 GBP AI tool development
- Initial investment: 750 GBP, Fixed assets: 320 GBP, No liabilities or loans

items.title: Workforce & Expansion
items.summary: 5 employees, 3 directors, 3 advisors, 38 robots. Expanding to Dubai, Belgium, Luxembourg, USA.
items.content:
Workforce: 5 current employees, 3 lifetime directors, 3 external advisors, and 38 AI robots.
6 intern batches completed, 7th running.
Expanding to Dubai, Belgium, Luxembourg, and USA.
Plan to reduce robot usage by 50%.

items.title: Corporate Social Responsibility
items.content: NobleRoot is committed to corporate social responsibility, offering training and courses to Bangladeshi students and young entrepreneurs, and focusing on environmental sustainability by minimizing its carbon footprint.
